B 0 -60 0 minecraft:test_instance_block
# a set on the live entity tells the comparators, which turn themselves off two ticks later
B -1 -60 0 minecraft:comparator[facing=east,mode=compare,powered=true]
B 0 -60 -1 minecraft:comparator[facing=south,mode=compare,powered=true]
B 0 -60 0 minecraft:test_instance_block

B 0 -60 -1 minecraft:comparator[facing=south,mode=compare,powered=false]
B 0 -60 0 minecraft:test_instance_block
# the reset clears the instance block through its structure
B 0 -60 -1 minecraft:comparator[facing=south,mode=compare,powered=true]

B 0 -60 -1 minecraft:comparator[facing=south,mode=compare,powered=false]
